summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. I build computer vision systems end to end, from dataset annotation and CNN training for object detection, semantic segmentation and depth estimation to a 5.2x TensorRT inference speedup on NVIDIA Jetson. I integrate vision into robotic control in C++ and Python, including a vision-guided pick-and-place arm and a microscopic defect inspection pipeline.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface defect inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free vision transformer, in PyTorch with the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API, raising validation accuracy from 55% to 93% on a custom medical billing dataset.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a 1,133-image object detection dataset and trained YOLOv8n to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net semantic segmentation CNNs with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 MRI data; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency across a Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket.
Optimized YOLO object detection inference with TensorRT on NVIDIA Jetson for a 5.2x speedup (56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS) driving closed-loop visual servoing.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale frames); wrote two-link IK in C++ on Arduino.
Built a multi-camera frame capture pipeline with multiprocessing; deployed the Jetson arm bridge on Linux as a systemd service with auto-restart and static IP networking.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Built YOLOv8 object detection and tracking on NVIDIA Jetson, streaming control commands to an STM32 over interrupt-driven UART for multi-servo PWM motion control.
Coordinated concurrent FreeRTOS tasks with mutex-protected shared memory, integrating VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance display.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Auto-labeled ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation using CARLA semantic segmentation; trained YOLO11n to mAP50 ~0.85.
